chart_report.classification: finite rooted chart sample pass: local IFT data are stable in sampled good-sector probes; uniform compact theorem still open

rn_report.classification: finite shifted RN sample pass: O(g) density coefficient is small and the odd-y O(g^2) channel is antithetically centered in the reference measure; exact compact conditional centering remains open

residual_gates.name: forbidden uncentered shifted odd density
residual_gates.meaning: If exact centering fails, the odd channel creates a nonsummable O(g^2) drift.

residual_gates.name: allowed centered shifted odd second cumulant

theorem_debts.label: BC1 uniform rooted chart
theorem_debts.finite_result: sampled shifted ∂K/∂k is invertible and principal-log margin is positive
theorem_debts.missing_uniform_statement: prove uniform invertibility over the full C5M good sector
theorem_debts.failure_trigger: minimum singular value approaches zero or log chart crosses the principal boundary

theorem_debts.label: BC2 exact RN expansion
theorem_debts.finite_result: finite ±g coefficient extraction shows the expected O(g)/O(g^2) structure
theorem_debts.missing_uniform_statement: derive analytic compact SU(2) RN expansion with controlled R_ge3
theorem_debts.failure_trigger: uncontrolled Haar/FP/retained-coordinate terms appear at O(g) or O(g^2)

theorem_debts.label: BC3 exact odd centering
theorem_debts.finite_result: antithetic reference high measure centers the shifted odd-y coefficient
theorem_debts.missing_uniform_statement: prove the true shifted conditional reference remains centered after compact disintegration
theorem_debts.failure_trigger: a nonzero conditional mean creates the forbidden O(g_j^2 M_j^2) drift

theorem_debts.label: BC4 quasilocality and exceptions
theorem_debts.finite_result: finite block has controlled gauge/reflection and FP diagnostics
theorem_debts.missing_uniform_statement: prove quasilocal constants and summable chart/large-field/near-Cartan exceptional bounds
theorem_debts.failure_trigger: constants grow with scale or exceptional-sector probability is nonsummable

decision.status: partial pass: finite rooted chart/RN diagnostics pass, but exact compact conditional centering and uniform RN theorem remain open
decision.next_checkpoint: C5BD: analytic shifted RN coefficient formulas. Replace finite ±g/finite-difference extraction by explicit g=0 source formulas for the shifted retained-coordinate, Haar, and FP terms.
decision.reason: C5BC builds the actual local compact-link map in rooted variables and finds no sampled forbidden O(g^2) drift.  The odd channel is centered by the antithetic reference measure, but this is not yet the exact compact conditional centering theorem.
